writing:wr:56.hint: 相手からのメールに対して感謝を伝える書き出しの表現は何か。
writing:wr:56.explanation: メールへの返信の書き出し。

writing:wr:57.hint: 自分の意見を支える理由が複数あることを述べる一文は何か。
writing:wr:57.answer: I have two reasons for the following opinion.
writing:wr:57.fullSentence: I have two reasons for the following opinion.
writing:wr:57.explanation: 意見を支える理由を導入する表現。

writing:wr:58.hint: 文章の締めくくりに使う、心を込めた結びの言葉は何か。
writing:wr:58.explanation: 手紙・メールの結びの言葉。

writing:wr:59.hint: ある意見が事実として広く認められていることを述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:59.answer: It is true that online classes offer more flexibility.
writing:wr:59.fullSentence: It is true that online classes offer more flexibility.
writing:wr:59.explanation: ~というのは事実だ、という構文。

writing:wr:60.hint: ある技術が人々に新しい行動を可能にすることを述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:60.answer: Smartphones enable us to stay connected with friends anytime.
writing:wr:60.fullSentence: Smartphones enable us to stay connected with friends anytime.

writing:wr:61.hint: あるものが別のものより多くの利点を持つことを述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:61.answer: Electronic dictionaries have several advantages over paper ones.
writing:wr:61.fullSentence: Electronic dictionaries have several advantages over paper ones.
writing:wr:61.explanation: ~より利点があるという構文。

writing:wr:62.hint: その問題について賛否が大きく分かれていることを述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:62.answer: It is a highly controversial issue whether or not the death penalty should be abolished.
writing:wr:62.fullSentence: It is a highly controversial issue whether or not the death penalty should be abolished.
keyPhrases: highly controversial issue whether or not
writing:wr:62.explanation: 賛否が分かれる論争的な問題を示す構文。

writing:wr:63.hint: 政府が強い対応策を取らなければならないと述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:63.answer: The government has to take drastic measures to reduce carbon emissions.
writing:wr:63.fullSentence: The government has to take drastic measures to reduce carbon emissions.
writing:wr:63.explanation: 思い切った対策をとる、という構文。

writing:wr:64.hint: ある問題が深刻な危険をもたらすことを述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:64.answer: Climate change poses a serious threat to coastal cities.
writing:wr:64.fullSentence: Climate change poses a serious threat to coastal cities.
writing:wr:64.explanation: 深刻な脅威をもたらす、という構文。

writing:wr:65.hint: 経済を活発にする助けとなることを述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:65.answer: Tourism can help boost the national economy.
writing:wr:65.fullSentence: Tourism can help boost the national economy.
writing:wr:65.explanation: 経済を活性化させる、という構文。

writing:wr:66.hint: 個人的な意見をまず述べてから、その理由を続ける構文は何か。
writing:wr:66.answer: In my opinion, students should be allowed to choose their own subjects.
writing:wr:66.fullSentence: In my opinion, students should be allowed to choose their own subjects.
writing:wr:66.explanation: 自分の意見を導入する構文。

writing:wr:67.hint: これまでに述べた理由を踏まえて結論を導く表現は何か。
writing:wr:67.answer: According to the reasons stated above, I support this policy.
writing:wr:67.fullSentence: According to the reasons stated above, I support this policy.
keyPhrases: according to the reasons stated above
writing:wr:67.explanation: 上記の理由により、という表現。

writing:wr:68.hint: 大学の評判が良いほど就職の可能性が高まると述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:68.answer: If a college is more prestigious, its graduates are more likely to get good jobs.
writing:wr:68.fullSentence: If a college is more prestigious, its graduates are more likely to get good jobs.
keyPhrases: are more likely to get good jobs
writing:wr:68.explanation: ~する可能性が高い、という構文。

writing:wr:69.hint: あるものが生活に欠かせないほど重要だと述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:69.answer: Clean water is indispensable for human health.
writing:wr:69.fullSentence: Clean water is indispensable for human health.

writing:wr:70.hint: ある考えに同意する意思を明確に述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:70.answer: I agree with the idea that students should wear school uniforms.
writing:wr:70.fullSentence: I agree with the idea that students should wear school uniforms.
keyPhrases: i agree with the idea that
writing:wr:70.explanation: ~という考えに同意する、という構文。

writing:wr:71.hint: 実際には別の見方をする人もいると述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:71.answer: Actually, some people argue that social media does more harm than good.
writing:wr:71.fullSentence: Actually, some people argue that social media does more harm than good.
writing:wr:71.explanation: ~と主張する人もいる、という構文。

writing:wr:72.hint: 何かが依然として主な原因の一つであると述べる構文は何か。
writing:wr:72.answer: Traffic accidents are still one of the leading causes of death among teenagers.
writing:wr:72.fullSentence: Traffic accidents are still one of the leading causes of death among teenagers.
keyPhrases: are still one of the leading causes of
writing:wr:72.explanation: 依然として主要な原因の一つだ、という構文。

writing:wr:73.hint: 塾のように、学校外で受験のために勉強する場所を表す語は何か。
writing:wr:73.answer: Many students in Japan attend a cram school after regular classes.
writing:wr:73.fullSentence: Many students in Japan attend a cram school after regular classes.

writing:wr:74.hint: 決まった形式の問題にはよく対応できるが自分で考える力が弱い、という様子を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:74.answer: Students who are good at answering patterned questions sometimes struggle to think for themselves.
writing:wr:74.fullSentence: Students who are good at answering patterned questions sometimes struggle to think for themselves.
writing:wr:74.explanation: 定型的な問題に強いという意味。

writing:wr:75.hint: 生徒が視野の狭い人間になってしまうことを表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:75.answer: Too much focus on test scores can make students become narrow-minded.
writing:wr:75.fullSentence: Too much focus on test scores can make students become narrow-minded.
writing:wr:75.explanation: 視野の狭い人間になるという意味。

writing:wr:76.hint: 社会に出た後の厳しい現実を身をもって知る、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:76.answer: Working part-time helps students learn how harsh reality is.
writing:wr:76.fullSentence: Working part-time helps students learn how harsh reality is.
writing:wr:76.explanation: 現実の厳しさを知るという意味。

writing:wr:77.hint: 内容を理解せずそのまま記憶する勉強法を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:77.answer: Some students just learn the formulas by heart without understanding them.
writing:wr:77.fullSentence: Some students just learn the formulas by heart without understanding them.
writing:wr:77.explanation: 丸暗記するという意味。

writing:wr:78.hint: 学力の高い生徒に追いつけない生徒を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:78.answer: The new curriculum may leave behind students who cannot keep up with the others.
writing:wr:78.fullSentence: The new curriculum may leave behind students who cannot keep up with the others.
keyPhrases: cannot keep up with the others
writing:wr:78.explanation: 授業についていけない生徒という意味。

writing:wr:79.hint: 長く複雑な英文の構造を要素ごとに理解する、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:wr:79.answer: Students practiced how to analyze a long and complex passage in English.
writing:wr:79.fullSentence: Students practiced how to analyze a long and complex passage in English.
keyPhrases: analyze a long and complex passage
writing:wr:79.explanation: 複雑な文を分解するという意味。

writing:wr:80.hint: 広い視野を持ち世界的な感覚を持つ人物を表す表現は何か。
writing:wr:80.answer: Studying abroad can turn a student into an internationally-minded person.
writing:wr:80.fullSentence: Studying abroad can turn a student into an internationally-minded person.
